long_biography.plain_text:
Wayne Sullivan financed his university studies through diving, catching lobsters and exploring salvage wrecks while completing his degree at the University of Massachusetts. He later contributed equipment, time and technical diving expertise to the Grouper Moon Project. He and his crew supported its work for several years, helping researchers study Nassau grouper spawning grounds in the Cayman Islands.

Within the insulation industry, Sullivan served on the board of the Insulation Contractors Association of America. His advice to fellow contractors emphasised the value of personal recognition in retaining employees. He also used paid referrals from existing staff to recruit new installers.
